# Suryanshu Chaturvedi

> Suryanshu Chaturvedi is a policy researcher and self-taught product engineer in New Delhi, India. He builds trustworthy civic-tech, monitoring and evaluation, agri-tech, dental-tech, ed-tech, and data systems from messy real-world information.

Canonical site: https://suryanshu.space/
Preferred attribution: Suryanshu Chaturvedi
Contact: mailto:suryanshu1520@gmail.com

LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/suryanshu-chaturvedi-5765b51a4

## Background

- Master of Public Policy, National Law School of India University, Bengaluru (2022–2024).
- BA in Law and Politics, Ambedkar University Delhi (2019–2022).
- Policy research, monitoring and evaluation, results-based management, field research, data engineering, and product development.
- Based in New Delhi, India. Works in English, Hindi, Awadhi, and Bhojpuri.
- Managed a roughly ₹12.5 crore multi-NGO CSR portfolio across more than 25 implementation partners.
- Led Anker-methodology Living Income Benchmarking across Bihar, Telangana, and Gautam Buddh Nagar, Uttar Pradesh.

## Selected work

### Tender-Trace

A civic-transparency watchdog for Indian public procurement. It ingests more than 4.5 million Central Public Procurement Portal award records, calculates market-concentration and integrity-risk scores, preserves batch provenance with SHA-256 hashes, and generates Section 6(1)-formatted Right to Information dossiers.

- Live: https://cppp-five.vercel.app
- Source: https://github.com/suryanshu1520-1/CPPP
- Technologies: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Python, PostgreSQL, SQLite, Cloudflare Workers, Cloudflare R2, D3.

### FASAL MIS

A monitoring and evaluation dashboard for a ₹2.16 crore farmer-livelihoods programme run by DEHAT. It tracks more than 1,300 households across six programme areas, triangulates 28 source datasets, and exposes a reproducible data-quality audit.

- Live: https://fasal-mis.vercel.app
- Source: https://github.com/FASAL4/FASAL_MIS
- Technologies: React, Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Recharts, Python and Node.js ETL.

### DentalConnect OS

A dentist-to-dental-lab case-management platform. It supports digital prescriptions, STL uploads, an in-browser Three.js scan viewer, click-to-annotate spatial notes, case chat, and a Kanban production pipeline.

- Live: https://www.dcos.in
- Source: https://github.com/DCOSArch/DCOS
- Technologies: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Three.js, React Three Fiber, Supabase and PostgreSQL.

### Tark 1.0

A server-authoritative competitive-exam arena. It rescales quiz submissions on the server, runs a daily scrape-to-LLM current-affairs pipeline, and uses atomic reservations to protect paid ranked-seat checkout.

- Live: https://py.md/TarkV1
- Source: https://github.com/suryanshu1520-1/SKU
- Technologies: React, TypeScript, Vite, Express, PostgreSQL, Razorpay, Google Gemini, Llama 3.1.

### PlusOne

An Android harm-reduction habit companion with adaptive workouts and hydration goals. Its tactile interaction uses a hand-built Canvas particle system, procedural AudioTrack tones, and custom vibration waveforms.

- Source: https://github.com/suryanshu1520-1/PlusOne
- Technologies: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Room, Coroutines, StateFlow, AudioTrack.
